items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author lemma-Kummer at source lines 3447-3473 (statement 3447-3453, proof 3455-3473) of stacks-fields. Quality triage 2026-10-14 accepted; no omission markers, citations or diagram markup in the counted span; the bridge 'Since zeta is a root of x^n - 1 by linear algebra there is a 0 != z in L such that sigma(z) = zeta z' (source lines 3465-3467) is the author's own terse carried step: x^n - 1 is the minimal polynomial of sigma and splits with simple roots over K, so zeta is an eigenvalue; the fixed-field step 'sigma(z^n) = z^n so z^n in K' is L^{Gal(L/K)} = K of theorem-galois-theory (delivered L48341); the generation step uses that the n distinct conjugates zeta^i z force [K(z) : K] >= n = [L : K]; recorded here per the terse-pass rule; content verbatim.
